candidate: run-5 ep19 student (DLV3+/EfficientNet-B0 @320x240), selected by the pre-stated rule: best val Dice among epochs with control fire <= 7.5%

adoption_trial.procedure: full batch-study pipeline rerun with the student on all 60 clips; operating point derived on calib only by the same pre-stated zero-false-alarm criterion as the teacher's; test population opened once
adoption_trial.frozen_rule: camera-frame clustering, support >= 11 (calib: 4/9 polyp clips, 0 false alarms)

flagged_controls.note: teacher maxC=1 on this clip; student maxC=39 - a persistent out-of-body false alarm and a qualitatively new failure mode

on_device.measured: 2026-10-03, in-app benchmark card (12 runs, median), Pixel-class phone, CPU
on_device.note: quiet frames (the screener does not fire) cost only the student; fired frames cost both stages and are re-decided by the teacher. The in-app card re-measures this live on any device.

verdict.replacement: NOT ADOPTED, by the strict reading of the pre-stated bar: the teacher's documented claim ('every flagged control is genuine non-polyp pathology; zero fires on normal mucosa') is broken by the hand clip. Detection and discrimination are equivalent-or-better, and 'zero on normal mucosa' still holds, but a hand pinned as a polyp with support 39 is outside the teacher's band.
verdict.deployment: CASCADE adopted as the design consequence: the student (3.4-4.8x faster) screens every frame during live operation; any frame it fires on is re-checked by the teacher before entering persistence clustering. Findings on the map remain teacher-grade by construction; the hand failure mode is filtered by the confirming teacher (maxC=1 on that clip). Per-frame cost on non-firing footage drops to the student's.
verdict.method_note: the v1 rejection (results/distill_student.json) and this v2 arc are both kept: v1's accuracy gate compared against a number the external evaluation showed to be inflated by base-model train-on-test; v2 re-stated the gates before any external number existed (results/distill_protocol_v2.md, commit e70c6b8) and the candidate passed them - then still did not earn full replacement, because the adoption bar caught a failure mode no aggregate gate measured. Three layers of pre-stated criteria, each catching something the previous one could not.
